title: Define DAO two-slot generation exhaustion behavior
description: P3 robustness/security: TwoSlotFilePersistence computes max(gen0, gen1)+1 and serializes as >I without handling 0xffffffff. At exhaustion every subsequent TX/RX replay-floor commit raises raw struct.error, permanently disabling DAO operation rather than a defined fail-closed persistence error or safe epoch transition. Validate generation arithmetic, surface DaoPersistenceError, and specify/test exhaustion recovery without permitting rollback.
